summary: Verified Dr. Jellybone stroller direction fix on Plaza homepage (/#/home) and regression-tested Campus play zone strollers. All checks pass. Dr. Jellybone now travels right (dx=+68.5 over 1.5s) with computed transform scaleX=-1 (mirrored so his left-facing art points right - toward motion). Visual zoomed screenshot confirms his face and saxophone point right. Sharky unchanged: travels left (dx=-58.2) with scaleX=-1 (right-facing art mirrored to face left) - visual confirmed. Campus /#/campus?zone=play strollers (string-entry form): charlie-surf travels right with scaleX=+1 (not mirrored); sharky-snorkel travels left with scaleX=-1 (mirrored). No console errors other than expected 404s on assets/voice/*.mp3.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is clean and minimal: Swimmer `facing` prop with flip = (dir==='right'?1:-1) * (facing==='left'?-1:1) correctly handles both art orientations. String-entry back-compat preserved in CampusMapPage strollers map.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Stroller direction/orientation fix (iteration_49) verified on Plaza (Dr. Jellybone, Sharky) and Campus play zone (charlie-surf right+unflipped, sharky-snorkel left+flipped). Sampling method: compare bounding_box().x at two timestamps ~1.5s apart and parse getComputedStyle(el).transform matrix first value for scaleX sign.
